steamtown-heritage-rail-centre.name: Steamtown Heritage Rail Centre
steamtown-heritage-rail-centre.bio: Peterborough's heritage roundhouse and rail sheds hold steam locomotives and carriages from the town's narrow-gauge junction days.

notes.pin: Wikivoyage listing geotag -32.9751 138.826 for the centre itself (1 Telford Avenue); draft hint matches.
notes.cost: $15/person guided tour per Wikivoyage, undated; not confirmed on the official site.
notes.status: Official site (title checked: Steamtown Heritage Railway - Peterborough) says the centre and the Peterborough Visitor Information Centre are temporarily closed under Peterborough council while a new operating model is developed, aiming to reopen for the 2026 tourist season. Still add (a permanent venue) but confirm reopening before shipping.

town-carriage-museum.name: Town Carriage Museum
town-carriage-museum.bio: Museum in railway carriages at Peterborough, a former rail junction town, with displays on its railway history.

notes.pin: Wikivoyage listing geotag -32.9736 138.8392 for the museum itself (Main Street area; council notice puts a carriage at 122 Main Street by the playground); verify on the serial pass.
notes.cost: No price or free status found in any fetched source.
notes.status: Wikivoyage entry dated Jul 2021 with no detail; may be tied to the council's temporary closure notice. Verify it is open to the public before shipping; if not it fails the access test.

peterborough-historic-letterpress-print-.name: Peterborough Historic Letterpress Print Shop
peterborough-historic-letterpress-print-.bio: Volunteers run tours of a working letterpress print shop at Peterborough, with three presses including an 1910 Wharfedale.

notes.pin: Address 7-9 Jervois Street, Peterborough SA 5422 (tourism board listing); no geotag found.
notes.cost: Tour price not stated on the listing; hands-on print-making is pre-booked.
